meaning: This is an intended invalid-key repair, not native rendering equivalence. Native URL is not consumed. Existing unique normalized-key repair remains available only for one exact ASCII case variant, supplied validated literal HTTP(S) URL, and no lower-case url or positional1 competing field including blank.
quietRefusal: control/Unicode whitespace in URL or original key
refusalAttribution: Unsupported raw complete native/local-call argument layouts are opaque to all stages; this prevents comments/PUA/key padding becoming false certainty after masking or trimming.
